messages.subject: Re: How to Insert MotionChart In ShinyApp?
parts:
You can use the googleVis package to do this. You will not be able to see the chart unless it is loaded on an actual browser like Chrome, Firefox etc. 

Here is a link to the googleVis example page for R : http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/googleVis/vignettes/googleVis_examples.html

Here is a link to the page on how to combine this with Shiny
http://www.inside-r.org/packages/cran/googleVis/docs/renderGvis

Good Luck, 

Amber
